The focus order departs from the reading order (focus jumps back up the page from "Dial-A-Moon API" (link) to "Media Group Items" (link); focus jumps back up the page from "Further Assistance" (link) to "Copy a link to this section" (button); focus jumps back up the page from "" (link) to "" (link); focus jumps back up the page from "Copy a link to this section" (button) to "media items" (link); focus jumps back up the page from "libration" (link) to "position angle" (link); focus jumps back up the page from "Reproduction Guidelines" (link) to "Mark SubbaRao" (link)), and we could not tell whether that matters. Please tab through the page and check. After opening "Can I use your visualizations?" (button), the next Tab moves into what it revealed.
